Use this section when starting a project, inheriting one, or trying to make an existing project recoverable.

- [Minimum GeoEpi Standard](minimum-standard.qmd)
- [Starting a New Project](new-project.qmd)
- [Rescuing an Existing Project](rescue-project.qmd)
- [Project Handoff](handoff.qmd)

For the task workflow, continue from [Plan a Project](../practices/plan/index.qmd), [Plan Data Management](../practices/plan/data-management-planning.qmd), or [Data Intake and Acceptance](../practices/acquire/data-intake.qmd). The Research Practices pages contain the detailed guidance; these Start Here links are gateways, not duplicate checklists.

The [Minimum GeoEpi Project Standard](minimum-standard.qmd) is a proposed draft policy requiring human review. The supporting pages are practical guidance, not approved lab policy.
